rec: Combat gear to kill the ghasts

st.t: Talk to Drezel under the Paterdomus Temple.
s: Well, what is it, I may be able to help?

st.t: Pass through the Holy Barrier next to Drezel and cross the nearby bridge. Go south and enter Mort Myre Swamp through the north gate. You must use the gate, or Filliman won't appear.
Attempt to enter the Grotto in the south of Mort Myre.
s: How long have you been a ghost?

st.t: Talk to Filliman Tarlock.
s: How long have you been a ghost?

st.t: Take the washing bowl from the bench next to the grotto. The mirror is underneath it.
Pick up the mirror.
Use the mirror on Filliman Tarlock.
s: How long have you been a ghost?

st.t: Long-press the grotto tree and choose Search.
Use the journal on Filliman Tarlock.
Return to Drezel under the Paterdomus Temple to get blessed.
Cast the druidic spell next to a rotten log in Mort Myre to grow a mushroom, then pick it. If you've lost the spell, ask Filliman for another.
s: Could I have another bloom scroll please?

st.t: Use the mushroom on the brown stone outside the grotto. If you've already done this, tap Done. If you aren't sure, search the stone: it says it seems complete once it has the mushroom.
Use the used spell on the gray stone outside the grotto. If you've already done this, tap Done. If you aren't sure, search the stone: it says it seems complete once it has the spell.
i: A used spell or druidic spell

st.t: Stand on the orange stone outside the grotto.
While standing on the orange stone, tell Filliman Tarlock you're ready. If he isn't there, attempt to enter the grotto so he appears, then stand on the orange stone again.
s: I think I've solved the puzzle!

st.t: Enter the Grotto in the south of Mort Myre.
Search the grotto inside.
Talk to Filliman in the grotto to bless your sickle.
Talk to the Nature Spirit in the grotto to bless your sickle.
Stand next to a rotten log, long-press the blessed sickle and choose Cast Bloom for mort myre fungi. Pick them and use them to fill the druid pouch.
Use the filled druid pouch on a ghast to make it attackable and kill it. You'll need to kill 3.
Enter the Grotto in the south of Mort Myre.
Search the grotto in the middle of the cave so the Nature Spirit appears, then talk to him to finish the quest!
